message:
I remember the time we had a big storm warning, and my neighbor, bless her heart, turned into a one-woman emergency preparedness show. She had enough bottled water to start a small convenience store and was offering everyone in the neighborhood homemade beef jerky. I stood there with my one extra flashlight and a can of soup, feeling a tad underprepared. But you know what? I realized that sometimes, a little over-preparedness can be a comfort, especially when the winds start howling. So, I took her up on that jerky and we hunkered down with a game of cards while the storm passed. 

What’s your go-to tip for feeling ready when the weather turns? 🌧️
